The death of a pet happens off screen

playerLine: I kneel beside the old hound.
narration: The old hound lifts his head once to find your hand. You stay with him, and feel the long slow breath go out of his ribs, and then the next one that does not come, and his eyes go from bright to still under your palm.

characterContext.playerSummary: A ferry-hand with a borrowed name.
